messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline 25 mg tablets
Sertraline 50 mg tablets
Sertraline 100 mg tablets
Sertraline oral solution, 20 mg per mL
Sertraline 150 mg capsules
Sertraline 200 mg capsules
Capsule strengths are based on sertraline itself.
A 150 mg capsule contains 168 mg of sertraline hydrochloride.
A 200 mg capsule contains 224 mg.
Capsule appearance and imprints differ between manufacturers.
Triplet: ["capsule", "based on", "sertraline"]

The relation 'based on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is formulated or derived from the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined or described by the specification provided in the object entity.
B. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'involves': The subject condition or process includes or is characterized by the entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'are copies of': The subject entity is a synthetic or artificial version of the entity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
